DropWise — The Daily Water Intake Tracker That Keeps You Hydrated

Set personalized hydration goals, log every sip in seconds, and watch gentle reminders turn into a lasting habit. Join over 250,000 people who finally drink enough water every day.

Download DropWise Free See Features

Everything you need to stay hydrated

Smart Reminders

Adaptive notifications learn your schedule and nudge you at the right moments, not just every hour on the clock.

One-Tap Logging

Log a glass, bottle, or custom amount in a single tap, with quick shortcuts for your favorite cups and bottles.

Personalized Goals

DropWise calculates your ideal daily intake from your weight, activity level, and climate, then adjusts over time.

Progress Insights

Weekly and monthly charts reveal your hydration streaks and help you spot patterns before dehydration hits.

Widgets & Wearables

Log water straight from your home screen widget or smartwatch — no need to even open the app.

Fun Achievements

Earn badges and streak milestones that keep hydration feeling like a game, not a chore.

A closer look at the app

Clean, friendly screens designed to make tracking water feel effortless.

Loved by hydrated humans everywhere

"I used to forget to drink water for hours at work. DropWise's reminders actually feel helpful instead of annoying."

— Maria Chen, Marketing Manager

"The weekly chart made me realize I barely drank anything on busy days. Three months in and my energy levels are so much better."

— Daniel Ortiz, Teacher

"Logging water from my watch widget takes two seconds. It's the only health app I've actually stuck with."

— Priya Nair, Nurse

Frequently asked questions

Is DropWise free to use?

Yes. DropWise is free to download with all core tracking features included. An optional Pro plan unlocks advanced analytics and extra widget themes.

Which devices does DropWise support?

DropWise runs on iOS 15 and later, Android 9 and later, and syncs with most popular smartwatches including Apple Watch and Wear OS devices.

How does DropWise calculate my daily goal?

We use your weight, activity level, and local climate data to suggest a starting goal, then refine it automatically as you log your intake over time.

Can I track other drinks besides water?

Yes, you can log tea, coffee, and other beverages with adjustable hydration values, so your totals stay accurate.

Is my data private?

Your hydration data stays on your device and our secure servers only for backup and sync. We never sell personal data to third parties.

Start drinking smarter today

Download DropWise now and get your first hydration reminder in under a minute.

DropWise

123 Hydration Ave, Suite 400, Austin, TX 78701

Email: hello@dropwise.app · Phone: (512) 555-0147
